items.definition:
relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings
We need to address ecological issues.

free from an obligation or liability imposed on others
Students with high grades are exempt from the final exam.

not true because based on erroneous information or reasoning; not legally or officially acceptable
The argument was based on invalid assumptions.

of little weight; not serious or important
This new laptop is very lightweight and easy to carry.

widespread in a particular area or at a particular time
The disease is more prevalent in tropical regions.

doubtful as regards truth, quality, or propriety
His business practices are highly questionable.

existing or available in large quantities; plentiful
The forest is abundant with wildlife.

relating to or based on comparison
We need to do a comparative analysis of the two systems.

able to be believed; convincing
The witness provided a credible account of the accident.

living forever; never dying or decaying
Many myths tell stories of immortal gods and goddesses.

not enough; inadequate
There was insufficient evidence to prove his guilt.

exact; not figurative
You should take his words in a literal sense.

relating to the moon
The lunar eclipse was a spectacular sight.

relating to a mother
She has strong maternal instincts.

shockingly bad or excessive
The prices at that restaurant are simply outrageous.

secretly gathering information
The detective went undercover to investigate the crime.

causing horror; dreadful
The accident was a horrific sight.

extraordinary; remarkable
Her performance was absolutely phenomenal.

relating to photography or photographs
He has a photographic memory.

able to be foreseen or foretold
The movie's ending was very predictable.

strange or odd; relating to sexual or gender minorities
He felt a queer sensation in his stomach.

not staining or rusting
We bought a new set of stainless steel pans.

relating to stars; outstanding
She gave a stellar performance in the play.

relating to discipline
The employee faced disciplinary action for his misconduct.

having limits or bounds
Our natural resources are finite.

about to happen or appear
The forthcoming election will be very close.

well known for some bad quality or deed
He was infamous for his terrible temper.

providing or showing inspiration
Her story was truly inspirational.

lasting or continuing throughout a person's life
He has been a lifelong friend.

innocent, inexperienced
She was very naive to believe everything he said.

stiff, inflexible
The rules were too rigid to allow for any exceptions.

magnificent, excellent
We had a splendid time at the party.

not fair, sensible, or practical
His demands were completely unreasonable.

relating to the medical care of animals
She decided to pursue a career in veterinary medicine.

producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind
She had a vivid dream about flying.

having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities
His arrogant attitude made him unpopular with his colleagues.

made of clay and hardened by heat
She bought a beautiful ceramic vase.

unique; referring to one
This is a singular opportunity that won't come again.

vertical; honest
Please keep the box upright.

conceited; useless
She is very vain about her appearance.

worth the time, money, or effort spent
It was a worthwhile experience despite the challenges.

relating to or using signals or information represented by a continuously variable physical quantity
I prefer the warm sound of analog records over digital music.

relating to or using analysis or logical reasoning
She has a very strong analytical mind, which helps her solve complex problems.

relating to or caused by bacteria
The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the bacterial infection.

declared in law unable to pay outstanding debts
The company went bankrupt after several years of financial losses.

occurring at the end of or as a result of a process or period of time
The eventual outcome of the negotiations was a peace treaty.

long-standing
They have been longtime friends.

paranoid
He felt paranoid after watching the thriller.

retro, vintage
She loves wearing retro clothes from the 80s.

done or existing alone
He enjoys solitary walks in the woods.

stylish and sophisticated
She looked very classy in her new dress.

of a higher quality and more luxurious
We booked a deluxe room with a view.

possible to do easily or conveniently
It's a feasible plan, but it will require a lot of effort.

sexually attracted to people of one's own sex
The documentary explored homosexual relationships.

unable to do something
He seemed incapable of understanding the instructions.

Much smaller than normal.
She collected miniature dollhouse furniture.

Relating to a job or profession.
He suffered from an occupational hazard.

without weapons
The police officer approached the unarmed suspect cautiously.

illegal
It is unlawful to park here without a permit.

not normal
The doctor noticed an abnormal growth.

enough or more than enough
There was ample time to finish the project.

tough, impressive, or intimidating
That superhero is totally badass.

relating to beauty or appearance
The changes were purely cosmetic and didn't affect performance.

having the shape of a cube
The box had a volume of one cubic meter.
